# Requisitions Anonymous
Nobody asks where the stock comes from. The Company would prefer to keep it that way.
- What it is: a discreet requisitions console selling curated goods for Corporate Standing instead of credits. Think of it as the black market with a customer-service smile.
- Where to find it: look for the REQUISITIONS ANONYMOUS wallmount, present on every rotation map.
- Steps to first success: - Click the console to browse the current stock and prices, listed in Standing. - Pick a listing you can afford and confirm the purchase. - The console tells you immediately whether the purchase succeeded or failed — you do not have to guess. - Your item does not appear in your hands. It is delivered shortly after, [italic]out of band[/italic] — give it a few seconds after a successful purchase before assuming something went wrong. - Stock refreshes after every successful sale, so a listing you missed may reappear differently priced later.
- Standing is the same balance tracked on your Season Ledger. See that page, and Salary & Standing, for how to earn more of it.
